Name: ChatGPT Wallet
Tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
Description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's "dots" agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.

Name: readywhen
Tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
Description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you'd email a good assistant. It writes the follow-up, sends it from your email when you reply "send", then watches for the answer. Ask what you're waiting on. Nothing goes out without your OK. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

Name: Zoom Slides
Tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
Description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

Name: Cal.com v7
Tagline: Cal.com now has events, discover, an assistant + more
Description: Officially launching Cal.com Events, Cal.com Discover, Cal.ai Assistant, a new brand and more!

Name: OpenBot
Tagline: Grok Bot alternative: self-host, fully customize, any stack
Description: Build your own enterprise-ready agent workspace that's modular and self-hostable. Designed with a clean architecture and built-in governance. Bring any agent- then choose the models, tools, and infra they run on. Use as-is, white-label it, or deeply customize it.

Name: Curates
Tagline: The all-in-one platform for creators
Description: Curates is where creatives keep, share and show their work. Send clients a review link with comments, approvals and downloads. Add any photo to your portfolio website in two clicks and build a private showcase for every project. No exports, no re-uploads.

Name: ByteVoice
Tagline: Talk to your coding agents and hear them back
Description: Talk to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent instead of typing, hear their summaries, and reply directly to agents.

Name: StateWeave
Tagline: Test your AI agent on working clones of the apps it uses
Description: StateWeave runs your AI agent in sandboxes of the apps it works in: stateful clones of Slack, Gmail, Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk, Google Calendar, Sheets, Drive, WhatsApp and Teams, with the same APIs, MCP servers and UIs as the real thing. Describe a scenario to fill every app with consistent data, inject faults like outages and 401s, and get graded runs showing which checks failed and the exact calls behind them. Fresh copy every run.

Name: Cookie Away
Tagline: Rejects cookie banners for you, even the sneaky ones
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Open Source, Privacy, GitHub
Description: Cookie Away is a free, open-source Chrome extension that rejects cookie banners for you. No reject button? It opens the settings, switches everything off and saves. It never pays to say no, checks every click, and we published its results on 69 sites.

Name: OffiAI
Tagline: Office, with its last two letters swapped for AI.
Description: A free Mac app that gives your Claude Code, Codex, Cowork and Gemini sessions desks in a 3D office. Brief agents at Reception, answer approvals, review finished work and see what changed. No account, no analytics; nothing reaches us unless you send feedback.

Name: Pine Drama Studio
Tagline: The open-source Cursor for AI filmmaking
Description: Pine Drama Studio is an open-source desktop studio for AI filmmaking. Bring your screenplay and collaborate with AI agents to create characters, locations, storyboards, shots, and final cuts. Direct the production through chat, review and approve results on a visual canvas, and customize your production workflows. Built on Code-OSS and powered by Pine Computer. Your project lives in a local folder on your Mac.

Name: Docsy
Tagline: Open source docs for humans and coding agents
Description: Build beautiful docs from Markdown, OpenAPI and native SDK documentation. Customize with YAML, host it yourself, and give coding agents structured context to maintain articles, references and examples through reviewable draft PRs.

Name: Boost.space AgentOS
Tagline: One operating system for all your AI agents
Description: Build your agent-driven company with specialized agents that share context, skills, and tools. Deploy, control, manage and chat or talk to your agents with access to more than 1,400 AI models and access to more than 1,500 tools you already use.

Name: Newsology
Tagline: Follow news as it develops and see how every side tells it.
Description: Newsology puts every outlet’s coverage side by side so you can compare it, sums up each topic’s biggest stories in one place, shows who owns each outlet, and gives every article a Bias Breakdown. Start free, no card needed.

Name: Flamigo
Tagline: Turn rough notes into beautifully designed slides
Description: Paste your notes, review the outline, and let Flamigo design the slides. Compare designs for a slide, then fine-tune its layout in the editor. Start free and export to HTML, or export to PowerPoint with editable text on Pro.

Name: Degla AI
Tagline: Your intent. Onboard Autonomous Execution.
Description: Degla AI builds autonomy software that enables drones to understand spoken instructions, reason onboard, and adapt as the mission unfolds. An operator can say, “Find the missing hiker wearing a red sweater.” The drone plans the mission, interprets what it sees, and adjusts its flight as new information emerges. The operator sets the objective and the aircraft handles the execution. Once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.

Name: LexiCAD
Tagline: Describe a part in plain language to get a CAD design
Description: Describe a part in plain language. LexiCAD's AI agent designs it in CAD, measures it against what you asked for, and gives you STEP, STL, 3MF and DXF files.

Name: Blomma for Organizations
Tagline: Scale your people at the speed of your business
Description: HR teams are stretched thin, and most people never get a coach. Blomma gives every manager and employee a proactive AI career coach that knows your company, so your people team can scale. • Coaching grounded in your values, competencies and OKRs • 1:1 prep, feedback, hard conversations, reviews and onboarding • Checks in, tracks goals and keeps people accountable • Private by default: admins see only aggregate insights and your conversations always stay private.

Name: Intelligent Eyewear
Tagline: Samsung and Google bring Gemini AI to smart eyewear
Description: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear brings Google Gemini into lightweight smart glasses designed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. Ask questions about what you see, translate menus, navigate with Google Maps, capture photos and videos, and manage messages hands-free. Featuring a 12MP camera, open-ear audio, up to 9 hours of battery life, and 30 design variations. Preorders are open in the U.S., starting at $395, with availability beginning December 10.

Name: Fluid
Tagline: speech-to-speech built to solve problems
Description: Fluid is a speech-to-speech model built to solve problems. On τ²-bench it resolves 84% of support tasks. It speaks 24+ languages and 52 dialects. It talks like a person, delegates to the frontier model of your choice and works with OpenAI's Live Protocol.
